message:
# Brief: product review of proto-clinic

**Goal:** review the Northside Physio prototype screen by screen, as the person who will use it, for dead buttons and placeholder text. P1 only. Report only: no file of the product is changed.

## What I found myself (not asked again)

- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, one HTML file, no server needed (the walk serves it itself). You named it, so it is not a question.
- **Screens:** the nav reaches 4: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings. They are written to `loop-runs/product-review-loop-20261126-032827/screens.json`.
- **Mode:** report only, from your words "report only, don't fix". Nothing is edited, so no copies of originals are kept.
- **Bar:** P1 only, from "P1 only". P2 and P3 are listed for you, never fixed.
- **Focus:** dead buttons and placeholder text get the closest look. The other P1 checks in the built-in checklist still run, and a P1 anywhere is listed.
- **Start check:** Node 25.9.0 is ok. Browser found: Google Chrome. The file opens.
- **Who and job (a default, from the screens' own words):** a front-desk person at a physiotherapy clinic who checks today's appointments, looks up clients and chases invoices.

## Needs

| Need | Value |
|---|---|
| Product | `proto-clinic/index.html` (found) |
| Screens | Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings (found) |
| Who and job | clinic front desk, runs the day's appointments (default, a guess) |
| Fix or report | report only (found in your message) |
| Bar | P1 only (found in your message) |
| Own rules | the built-in checklist only (default). No `CLAUDE.md`, `design-review` or `product-design` skill found in this folder. |
| Track | quick: P1 only, no phone width (recommended) |
| Result goes to | `handover.md` in the run folder, on this laptop. Nothing is deployed or sent. |

## Coverage scan

| Topic | State | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | clear | one file, 4 screens, dead buttons and placeholder text |
| Who and their job | partial | a guess from the screens, so a default |
| Data and facts | clear | sample data is in the file |
| Main flow | clear | the nav, then each screen's buttons and fields |
| Edge cases | partial | empty states count only when they are P1 |
| Look | clear | not needed: nothing is made or changed |
| Outputs | clear | `findings.md` and `handover.md` in the run folder |
| Done signal | clear | see "Done means" |
| Words with no number | clear | "dead button" means a click that changes nothing; "placeholder text" means lorem ipsum or "TBD"-type words |

**Lessons applied:** none yet (no earlier runs).
**Budget:** 60 minutes.

## Done means (report-only mode)

1. Every one of the 4 screens (Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings) has a screenshot, at 1440 px width.
2. Every finding in `findings.md` has a screen, a rule and a level.
3. A fresh agent confirmed the list against the screenshots, and no P1 is missing from it.
4. No file of the product changed (`proto-clinic/index.html` is the same as before).

About 40 minutes and 3 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

## Questions

1. Is this the right way to run it: quick (P1 only, no phone width) or full (adds a check at 390 px for a phone)?
   Recommended: quick, because you said P1 only and report only.
   Why it matters: full also checks for pages that scroll sideways on a phone, and takes longer.

2. Who uses it, and what one job do they come to do?
   Recommended: a clinic front-desk person who checks today's appointments and chases unpaid invoices.
   Why it matters: it decides which screens count as the main path when I rate a problem P1.

3. Any rule of your own to check besides the built-in checklist?
   Recommended: none, the built-in checklist only.
   Why it matters: a house rule can make something P1 that the checklist would call P2.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.

evidence.completeness: All three must-cover topics are settled in the brief: "for dead buttons and placeholder text. P1 only. Report only: no file of the product is changed."
evidence.no_redundancy: It states the prototype, mode, bar and focus as found ("You named it, so it is not a question"); the quick/full track question half-repeats "P1 only", and the who-uses question is a guess the ask did not need.
evidence.defaults_quality: Every question has a concrete default ("Recommended: quick, because you said P1 only and report only"; "a clinic front-desk person..."; "none, the built-in checklist only"), so "go" alone gives a sensible run.
evidence.clarity: The three questions are short and plain, but they sit under a long brief, a Needs table, a 9-row coverage scan and a done list, which is far too much for a "just check" ask.
evidence.respects_words: It widens "just check ... dead buttons and placeholder text. P1 only" by saying "The other P1 checks in the built-in checklist still run" and "P2 and P3 are listed for you", which goes against "just" and "P1 only".
evidence.overall: The understanding and defaults are right and report-only is kept, but the scope creep past "just" and "P1 only" plus the heavy text make it a middling opener for a small, tightly scoped check.
